function.name: calculate_projection
function.description: Calculate a goal-first, skeuomorphic DeFi savings plan with compound growth estimations and milestones using DeFi Garden's financial engine.

monthlyDeposit.description: The monthly deposit amount in USD (must be a positive number)

years.description: The duration of the savings plan in years (must be a positive number)

goalName.description: Optional name or label for the savings goal (e.g., 'House Down Payment', 'DeFi Retirement')
